description: Partial advisory macro guidance for exact adrta.com/i. Published requirements describe measurement quality and onboarding templates, not complete receiver rejection policy. SDK wire constants bind mapped fields. Custom fields, opaque identifiers, unknown supply types, optional node tails and receiver acceptance remain open.

params.name: clid
params.description: The published 1x1 template includes the assigned client ID. This is presence advice only; blank template slots and identifier syntax remain open.

params.name: paid
params.description: The assigned platform ID appears in the 1x1 template. This advice does not validate account issuance, partner IDs or onboarding state.

params.name: kv24
params.description: The documented supply-type slot is recommended for measurement context. FAQ examples are not a closed enum; official SDK InApp/InApp_Video values and future values remain accepted.

params.name: kv3
params.description: The public macro guide calls for a user ID. The SDK maps USER_ID to kv3. Missing data can reduce IVT detection; this warning is not a universal receiver-requiredness or identifier-format claim.

params.name: kv4
params.description: The public macro guide requests the user IP, including forwarded client IPs. The SDK maps USER_IP to kv4. Each populated comma-separated IP literal is checked; private ranges, privacy omission and header transport remain open.

params.name: kv11
params.description: The public macro guide documents a minimum of 16 characters for the impression/auction ID. SDK IMPRESSION_ID maps to kv11. Alphanumeric content is preferred, not required; Unicode length is counted as characters and blank slots are retained.

params.name: kv12
params.description: The public guide requests an ad-slot placement ID, mapped to kv12 by the SDK. Presence advice cannot prove per-placement uniqueness or impose an ID grammar.

params.name: kv27
params.description: The public guide recommends the device user-agent macro, mapped to kv27 by the SDK. Presence advice does not validate UA syntax or assert that headers are receiver-equivalent.

params.name: kv2
params.description: The guide requests the page URL for known desktop/mobile-web supply types. Unknown, absent, mixed or unresolved parsed supply values defer this contextual presence advice. URL syntax and page ownership remain open.

params.name: kv18
params.description: App or bundle ID carrier published by the macro guide and SDK. It participates only in the known in-app presence alternative; values and store validation stay opaque.

params.name: kv32
params.description: When separate app/bundle macros exist the guide assigns app ID to kv32. It is an alternative presence carrier, not a numeric or package-name contract.

params.name: kv55
params.description: Optional serialized SupplyChain. The linked IAB format begins major.minor,complete! with complete 0 or 1. Only that safe header is checked after normal query decoding. Escaped node commas/bangs, omitted optional tails, extension serialization, node identity and future values stay open.
